title: The 'Your workouts are only on this phone' card is never shown or tapped in a test
what: Tests check only when the card is due and its main sentence. No test puts it on screen, checks its two button words, taps Sign in to reach Backup and restore, or checks that the made-up demo workouts do not count toward the three.
expected: A phone test that finishes three own workouts with the demo loaded, sees the card with both buttons, taps Sign in and lands on Backup and restore once.
fix_line: Add a phone test that shows the card and taps both buttons, and a rule test that leaves the demo out of the count

title: The 'Rest days' card and a deleted workout lowering the streak are never tested
what: The streak rule is tested well, but no test checks the 'Rest days' card at all (its dash and 'no workouts yet' for a new member) or that deleting a workout brings the streak down again.
expected: Tests that show the Rest days card for a new and a regular member, and that a deleted workout lowers the streak on every screen.
fix_line: Add a rule test for the Rest days words and a database test that deletes a workout and reads the streak again

title: Charts are never tested empty, failing, or after a workout is added or deleted
what: The phone test opens Charts only for a member full of demo data. No test checks the 'No workouts yet' page, the strength score's 'Add body weight' state, the Plus limit, the 'Try again' error, or that a new or deleted workout changes the numbers without a restart.
expected: Tests for the empty, no-body-weight, limit and error states, and one that adds then deletes a workout and sees Charts change.
fix_line: Add rule or screen tests for each Charts state and one refresh test

title: Erasing all data is never tested to clear the app icon shortcuts and home-screen widgets
what: Tests check what the shortcuts and widgets say for a member with data. Nothing checks that after Erase all data the long-press shortcuts are gone, a pinned Start icon is disabled, and the widgets go back to 'Open MettleUp' instead of showing the old routine and weights.
expected: A test that erases all data and then reads the shortcut list and widget data, finding nothing of the old member.
fix_line: Add a test that runs erase and checks the shortcut list and widget data are cleared

title: Opening MettleUp by sharing a Hevy or Strong file is never tested
what: Tests check only how the file type is guessed and part of the problem words. No test shares a file into the app, sees the Import screen open with the file chosen, checks the same share is not imported twice, or that sharing the same file again on purpose is taken.
expected: A phone test that shares a CSV into the app, sees the Import screen with the workouts, goes back, and shares again.
fix_line: Add a phone test that sends a share to the app and checks the Import screen

title: The Health Connect privacy link is checked only as text in the app's settings file
what: The test reads the app's settings file for the right address and entry points. Nothing opens the link from Health Connect, checks that a phone with no browser does not crash or leave a see-through screen, or checks the page says Health Connect data never goes to the gym, advertisers or an AI.
expected: A device check of the link, a no-browser check, and a check that the live policy page mentions Health Connect.
fix_line: Add a device or native test of the link and a page check of the policy words

title: The start-up screen is untested on older Android and when switching gyms back
what: The test records only that the app asks for a plain start-up screen once in a branded gym and resets it after leaving. Nothing checks phones on Android 12 or older (where it cannot change), or switching from an unbranded gym back to a branded one.
expected: Tests for the older Android path (no crash, no message) and for switching gyms back and forth.
fix_line: Add rule tests for the older Android and switch-back cases

title: The gym logo shortcut is tested only for its words and drawing
what: Tests check the words and how the logo is drawn. Nothing checks that the 'Gym logo on my home screen' row is hidden on a phone that cannot take shortcuts, that the shortcut stops opening the app as a member after leaving, or that it works again after joining.
expected: Tests that hide the row on such a phone and turn the shortcut off and on with leaving and joining.
fix_line: Add tests for the hidden row and the leave and rejoin cases

title: The Units page itself is never tested
what: Tests cover how pounds are shown and typed. No test opens Profile, Units, checks the two chips with one chosen, switches without a restart, or checks that no 'NaN' or 'undefined lb' appears after a switch.
expected: A screen test of the Units page that switches to pounds and sees a past set shown in lb at once.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the Units page and the switch
